subject: URGENT: Model-v7 quantized rollout causing 5xx/429 spike — customer impact
messages:
From: Diane Nguyen <diane.nguyen@blueline.finance>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, support@redwood.com
Cc: Rajesh Kapoor <rajesh.kapoor@blueline.finance>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 22:12:00 -0400
Subject: Production errors after latest model rollout (high 5xx / 429)

Ben —

We pushed live last night (your team’s model-v7, quant profile Q3) and since ~00:30 ET we’ve seen a steady spike in 5xx and 429s from the Redwood endpoint used by our payment reconciliation job. The job retries aggressively and our backlog is ballooning. Attached is a sampling of the error stream and a short CSV with per-minute error/throughput.

Impact: nightly reconcile failed (timeouts), customer-facing dashboards show delayed transactions, and engineering is throttling calls which hurts SLA.

Can you confirm if this is a known issue with Q3 quantization or a serving kernel change in v7? We need an ETA on mitigation and whether you can revert. This is urgent — we’re preparing an incident call with our CTO.

Thanks,
Diane
VP Engineering
Blueline Financial

Attachments: blueline_error_sample_0829.log (text), serving_metrics_snapshot_0829.csv (csv)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Diane Nguyen <diane.nguyen@blueline.finance>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, elliot_price@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 22:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production errors after latest model rollout (high 5xx / 429)

Diane — thanks for the rapid heads-up and the logs; I’m really sorry for the disruption. I’ve triaged the sample and we’re seeing elevated 5xx coming from the model process: OOM and kernel-level decode failures that correlate with the Q3 profile on v7. We also see the 429s clustered when the KV cache miss rate spikes.

Immediate plan:
- I’m spinning up an emergency rollback to model-v6 (non-quant) in the next 15 mins to stop additional client retries.
- Elliot + Priyom are instrumenting the Q3 variant to capture a full trace; Monica will coordinate the customer comms.

We’ll run the rollback in canary first and then promote if green. I’ll keep you updated every 15 minutes.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_rollback_cmds.txt (text)

From: elliot_price@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 22:41:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production errors after latest model rollout (high 5xx / 429)

On Sat, Aug 29, 2026 at 10:28 PM ben_carter@redwood.com wrote:
> I’m spinning up an emergency rollback to model-v6 (non-quant) in the next 15 mins to stop additional client retries.

Confirming: canary is live to 5% of traffic now. Initial telemetry shows 80% reduction in 5xx for that cohort within 6 minutes. We still observe retry amplification on the Q3 cohort; kernel decode errors are reproducible with the same input that Blueline provided.

Action items for SRE/Runtime:
- Capture full process core and model runtime logs (in progress).
- Pin kernel selection to legacy decode path for Q3 until we understand root cause.
- Rate-limit at the edge for Blueline to give us breathing room.

Elliot
SRE, Serving Runtime

Note: I put a temporary edge throttle rule (30r/s) on blueline token — will revert after rollback verified.

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Diane Nguyen <diane.nguyen@blueline.finance>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, elliot_price@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 00:05:00 -0400
Subject: Update: rollback and customer next steps

Diane —

Quick update from the team: we’ve initiated a partial rollback to model-v6 for your production tag and are seeing reduced 5xx/429 rates for the canary traffic. We will continue the rollback to 100% if the next 30 min window stays stable. We’ve also applied a temporary rate-limit on the token to blunt the retry storm while the rollback completes.

Customer-facing note we’d like to send (subject to your edit):
- We identified a regression in the recently deployed quantized model variant and rolled back your service to the previously-stable model. We are continuing post-mortem work and will share a technical summary and timeline within 48 hours.

Please confirm you’re OK with the messaging and whether you’d like an on-call escalation bridge (we can stand one up now).

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, elliot_price@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 03:12:00 -0700
Subject: Root cause early notes and repro

Folks —

Preliminary repro summary: the Q3 quant profile reduces weight precision at a hot attention kernel that, combined with a new fused attention decode kernel selected by the runtime for v7, produces NaN/overflow conditions on certain input-length distributions. This triggers downstream exceptions that surface as 5xx at the HTTP layer. The retry storm amplifies the failure due to edge retries + SDK client-side backoff misconfig.

Suggested mitigations:
- Roll back model to v6 (done for Blueline).
- Disable fused decode kernel selection for v7 until we ship a guarded kernel with saturation checks.
- Add a KV-prefetch tweak for long-sequence requests to reduce cache miss-triggered 429s.

I’ll open a post-mortem doc and attach trace IDs. We should notify product/engineers to hold further rollouts of v7+Q3 until guarded kernel is available.

—Priyom
Applied ML / Runtime

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, elliot_price@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Exec summary for leadership / customer follow-up

Team —

Thanks for the rapid response. Draft for leadership & customer:

Executive summary (to share internally and with Blueline):
- Incident: Elevated 5xx/429 observed for Blueline after rollout of model-v7 with Q3 quant profile.
- Cause (prelim): Interaction between Q3 quantization precision and new fused attention decode kernel in v7 producing numeric instability for specific input distributions.
- Mitigation: Rolled back Blueline to model-v6 (complete), applied temporary edge rate-limit, and disabled canary rollout for v7+Q3 globally.
- Next steps: 1) Patch kernel with saturation/NaN guards; 2) bake additional QA for quant/kernel combos; 3) share post-mortem and timeline within 48 hours.

Ask for leadership: approve a temporary global hold on v7+Q3 rollouts and a small engineering priority window (48 hours) to stabilize the kernel with a focused test harness.

If approved, I’ll join the customer bridge and present the summary.

Jonas Weber
Head of Runtime Engineering
